docs.text: Incident Response ¶ When to Use ¶ A production service is degraded or unavailable. Severity Levels ¶ Level Description Response Time SEV-1 Complete outage, all users affected Immediate SEV-2 Major feature broken, many users affected < 30 minutes SEV-3 Minor issue, workaround available < 4 hours Steps ¶ Acknowledge — confirm the incident in the team channel. Assess — determine severity and affected services. Communicate — notify stakeholders based on severity. Investigate — check logs, metrics, and recent deployments. Mitigate — apply a fix or rollback. Verify — confirm the service is healthy. Post-mortem — schedule a blameless review within 48 hours. Escalation ¶ If the issue is not resolved within the expected response time, escalate to the engineering lead. Useful Commands ¶ 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 # Check service health curl http://localhost:7007/healthcheck # View recent logs docker logs <container-name> --tail 100 # Restart a service docker restart <container-name>
